headline: Paraguay Senate approves deposit guarantee reform for Ueno Bank customers
summary: The Paraguayan Senate passed a reform to the deposit guarantee law allowing Ueno Bank customers to access an advance of up to 40 minimum wages within 24 hours of the bank's resolution by the Central Bank.
why: Deposit guarantee schemes are designed to maintain financial stability and prevent bank runs by protecting retail depositors in the event of a bank failure.

impacts.name: Ueno Bank
impacts.why: The bank is under resolution by the Central Bank, impacting its operations and customer liquidity.
